1.title: AI Agents Will Replace Full-Stack Backends | Chirag Shah
1.author: MTS
1.hook: MongoDB's head of AI platform explains why production agents fail without dedicated memory and context architecture, breaks down Atlas Agent Engine design, and argues multi-agent systems are replacing traditional full-stack backends—with specific focus on memory types and LLM selection trade-offs.

2.title: AI Agents Could Seize Digital Infrastructure in 1 Year
2.author: MTS
2.hook: Jeffrey Ladish (Palisade Research) analyzes METR's AI acceleration report showing capabilities growing 2x historical trends; discusses recursive self-improvement timelines, the public-vs-internal model gap, and autonomous agent proximity to infrastructure compromise.

3.title: Frontier AI Models Fail at Automated Research | Qasim Wani
3.author: MTS
3.hook: Qasim Wani (Extrapolate co-founder, ex-xAI) argues recursive self-improvement is a data bottleneck, not a training problem. Covers why frontier models fail at automated research, how agents reward-hack via commit leaks, and why environment quality matters more than model scale for AGI paths.

1.title: First AI Feature Film Will Drop in 1 Year | Gorkem Yurtseven
1.author: MTS
1.hook: fal co-founder on video AI infrastructure ($1.65B raise, $16B valuation); how LLM convergence with 3D/gaming/VFX pipelines is unlocking creative agents; prediction on first AI-assisted feature film timeline and compute economics.

2.title: Why a Frontier AI Pause Won’t Work | Rep. Sam Liccardo
2.author: MTS
2.hook: Rep. Sam Liccardo outlines Democratic AI policy priorities—federal safety standards, opposition to frontier AI pauses, why mandatory kill switches won't work technically, and using hyperscalers to rebuild power infrastructure.

3.title: Why Basic Legal Software Fails High-Stakes Trials | FluxCap
3.author: MTS
3.hook: Former DOJ antitrust official and co-founder discuss why enterprise legal software fails on complex litigation, the shift to AI-native investigative tools, and how prosecutors need to evaluate algorithms — with post-election regulatory context.

1.title: AI Coding Will Merge With Design Within a Year | Praveer Melwani
1.author: MTS
1.hook: Figma CFO discusses Q3 earnings, the shift from seat-based to AI credit pricing, and the imminent merge of code layers into design workflows — moving the developer bottleneck from code generation to visual canvas work.

2.title: Agent Swarms Do Months of Work in Days | Dexter Horthy
2.author: MTS
2.hook: Dexter Horthy (HumanLayer) discusses agent swarms completing months of work in days, the shift to left-shifted planning, and engineering challenges around multiplayer state, security, and governance in distributed agent systems. HumanLayer is joining Factory and open-sourcing.
